name: break
description: 9-ball break: seeded WPA rack (rack gaps derive from shot.seed, so a --seeds sweep re-racks every shot), full-speed center-ball break from the head spot. Demonstrates the {"rack": ...} scenario convenience and seed-driven outcome distributions.
provenance: Rack layout = pool-core rack.rs nine_ball_rack (apex on the foot spot, 9 centered, seeded 0.05-0.5 mm gaps per the internal break-physics report); break speed 8 m/s is a typical strong 9-ball break (pool-wasm ships the same schema with a 3 m/s placeholder shot).
